quota_model_docs._note: A plan may set quota_unresolved: true to skip the required-field check above when the conversion genuinely does not exist yet. Explain why in known_gaps.

plans.name: Claude Pro
plans.method: Awesome Coding Plan measured a saturated month on claude-opus-4.8 through Claude Code: 14,360 requests and 1.588B tokens, valued at $1,273.60 at Anthropic's API rates. The 5-hour window figure ($31.84) is the same measurement's 5-hour slice.

plans.name: Claude Max 5x
plans.method: Scaled from the measured Claude Pro quota by Anthropic's own advertised 5x multiplier for Max 5x. This is the vendor's claim carried through arithmetic, not an independent measurement. A real measured month would replace this row; see CONTRIBUTING.

plans.name: Claude Max 20x
plans.method: Scaled from the measured Claude Pro quota by Anthropic's own advertised 20x multiplier for Max 20x. This is the vendor's claim carried through arithmetic, not an independent measurement. A real measured month would replace this row; see CONTRIBUTING.

plans.name: ChatGPT Plus
plans.method: Awesome Coding Plan measured a saturated month on gpt-5.6-sol through Codex: 8,760 requests and 616M tokens, valued at $436.48 at OpenAI's API rates. No 5-hour window figure was published for this plan, so days_for_full_run uses the monthly cap only.

plans.name: ChatGPT Pro 20x
plans.method: Scaled from the measured ChatGPT Plus quota by OpenAI's own advertised roughly-20x multiplier for Pro over Plus. This is the vendor's claim carried through arithmetic, not an independent measurement.

plans.name: Cursor Pro
plans.method: Cursor states Pro includes at least $20 of API usage per month, plus unmetered use of its Auto router. $20 is the vendor-published floor, not an exhaustively measured ceiling, so the real number is likely higher.

plans.name: Cursor Pro+
plans.method: Cursor's own pricing page was unreachable from this build environment. Third-party aggregators agree Pro+ is $60/month at roughly 3x Pro's included pool but disagree on the exact dollar figure ($60 to $70). This row uses 3x Cursor Pro's $20 floor as a placeholder guess, not a vendor-confirmed number.

plans.name: Cursor Ultra
plans.method: Cursor's own pricing page was unreachable from this build environment. Third-party aggregators describe Ultra as roughly 20x Pro's included pool. This row uses 20x Cursor Pro's $20 floor as a placeholder guess, not a vendor-confirmed number.

plans.name: OpenCode Go
plans.method: OpenCode publishes Go's quota directly in dollars: $12 per 5 hours, $30 per week, $60 per month, spent across roughly two dozen open models. The vendor's discounted first month ($5) is excluded; this repo prices standard monthly billing only.

plans.name: Ollama Pro
plans.method: Ollama states Pro includes $60 of monthly usage directly, spent at Ollama's own per-token overage rates.

plans.name: GitHub Copilot Pro
plans.method: GitHub states Pro includes $15 of monthly usage credits directly.

plans.name: Kimi Code Andante
plans.method: Priced at CNY 49/month, sold only in China. Converted to USD at CNY 6.7787 per $1 (spot rate recorded 2026-09-04). Awesome Coding Plan measured a saturated month on kimi-k2.5: 2,556 requests, 84M tokens, valued at CNY 121.36. tasks_per_month divides requests_month by DeepSWE's agent steps per task, once data/models.json has a matching model.

plans.name: Kimi Code Allegretto
plans.method: Priced at CNY 199/month, sold only in China. Converted to USD at CNY 6.7787 per $1 (spot rate recorded 2026-09-04). Awesome Coding Plan measured a saturated month on kimi-k2.5: 36,292 requests, 1.428B tokens, valued at CNY 1,968.00.

plans.name: GLM Coding Plan Lite
plans.method: This is the CNY 49/month domestic (bigmodel.cn) product, converted to USD at CNY 6.7787 per $1 (spot rate recorded 2026-09-04), not Z.ai's international USD-priced plan. Awesome Coding Plan measured a saturated month on glm-5.1: 2,400 prompts, 128M tokens, valued at CNY 248.76. This project uses request count rather than Z.ai's published credit formula because the formula's real output weight has not been confirmed; see CONTRIBUTING.

plans.name: GLM Coding Plan Pro
plans.method: This is the CNY 149/month domestic (bigmodel.cn) product, converted to USD at CNY 6.7787 per $1 (spot rate recorded 2026-09-04), not Z.ai's international USD-priced plan. Awesome Coding Plan measured a saturated month on glm-5.1: 12,000 prompts, 640M tokens, valued at CNY 1,243.80. This project uses request count rather than Z.ai's published credit formula because the formula's real output weight has not been confirmed; see CONTRIBUTING.

plans.name: Google AI Pro
plans.method: Google states the monthly AI credit allotment directly, but has published no conversion from AI credits to tokens or API-rate dollars anywhere found. tasks_per_month cannot be computed. This row exists so the plan appears on the page, drawn hollow, rather than being silently missing.

known_gaps.reason: Price is disputed across every source checked ($99.99, $199.99 and the original $249.99 have all been reported since Google I/O 2026) and, like Google AI Pro, there is no published conversion from AI credits to tokens or dollars. Not priced until the current price is confirmed directly.

Z.ai's own pricing page and developer docs were unreachable from this build environment. Third-party aggregators disagreed on every tier's USD price. This repo prices the CNY-denominated domestic product instead, which was directly measured. Z.ai's published credit formula also needs its real output weight confirmed; see CONTRIBUTING item 3.

Figures for these tiers were found only via third-party aggregators, not Ollama's own pricing page (blocked from this build environment) or the CC BY 4.0 measured dataset this repo otherwise relies on.
SuperGrok's usage pool is shared across chat, image generation and agentic coding with no separate coding quota published. Any agentic-only cost per task would be invented.

deepswe.datacurve.ai is blocked by this build environment's network egress. No per-model score, cost per task, output tokens or agent steps could be retrieved with a citation. This is the highest priority open item; see CONTRIBUTING item 1 and 6.
A real measured quota exists in Awesome Coding Plan (CNY 49/month, 54,400 requests, CNY 4,344 value) but has not yet been added to plans.json.
